note: Building blocks beyond presets (behavior modelled on Animation Composer's packs, rebuilt from scratch), tagged like the library: energy 1 calm .. 5 explosive and tones. MCP list_kit. Transitions live in library/transitions.json. Reviewed side by side with AC previews (2026-10-14): smoke_puff, the generated light leak and the cinematic sweep were retired; lines now draw on, hold and travel off; rings are a shockwave; pops are particles; transitions use tonal palettes, a slight swing and motion blur. Behaviours (kind behavior, tools/ss_behaviors.jsx) are algorithms apart from what they draw, grouped by family (fill, swarm, physics, modifier); targets lists where each passed the side-by-side check (2026-10-14: bubbles on boxes, spring as a text mask and flock as a background were dropped as weak). Behaviour entries also carry their review verdicts as data: avoid = {target: why it failed}, pairs = what it combines well with. add_behavior refuses an avoided target with the reason and suggests the pairs; record new review verdicts here.

items.name: bubbles
items.use: Liquid bubbles that bloom from the origin and melt into each other (metaballs: blur + alpha threshold); as a background they rise like a lava lamp.

avoid.box: the text lands before the bubbles form a box (2026-10-14 review)
avoid.layer: not a modifier: it draws its own shapes

Settle or Surge curves, Stage duration

items.name: blob

items.name: grow
items.use: Organic growth: branches grow from the origin, wander and split like vines or roots, tapering each generation, buds at the tips.

avoid.transition: branches never cover the frame: corners stay open
avoid.box: a tree has no box shape

pairs: line_boil on the same layer (hand-drawn vines)
Settle or Cruise curves, Stage duration

items.name: flock
items.use: A flock or school crossing a region: a leader wanders on noise, members trail with their own lag and orbit, turned to their heading.

cinematic scenes with space to cross

items.name: spring
items.use: Jelly box: a rounded rectangle on the token curve whose edges lag and wobble like damped springs driven by the curve's speed, then settle.

avoid.mask: the jelly box contains the text, so nothing reads (2026-10-14 review)
avoid.transition: a box does not cover a frame with life
avoid.background: one box is not a background

pairs: label, button, price_tag and bubble elements
Pop or Nudge curves (Settle barely wobbles)

items.name: rope
items.use: Verlet rope: pinned at one end, the other carried into place on the token curve; it pays out, sags, swings and settles (an underline under a layer).

avoid.transition: a line never covers the frame
avoid.background: one rope is not a background

pairs: layer = a title: a rope underline that swings into place

items.name: line_boil
items.use: Hand-drawn line boil on any existing layer: outlines tremble as if redrawn on 3s (three drawings cycling). Shapes get Wiggle Paths, everything else a fine Turbulent Displace. The Collage style applies it.

avoid.shape: a modifier: apply it to existing layers (target layer)
avoid.background: a modifier: apply it to the background's layer instead
avoid.transition: boiling pieces flicker over the cut
avoid.box: apply it to the element's box layer with target layer

pairs: outlined shapes, drawn lines, grow, rope
the Boil preset (jitters the whole layer) for extra texture
